ents.s: THE FOLLOWING DETAILS NEED TO BE INCLUDED
REPAIR INFORMATION FOR PIER PILES WITH

details.name: PREPARATION OF PILE SURFACE FOR GROUTING

ents.s: PREPARATION OF PILE SURFACE FOR GROUTING
CLEAN OUT DEBRIS AND DECOMPOSED TIMBER WITH HIGH
EXPOSED TIMBER SURFACES WITH A 'CORK LIKE' DENSITY
SHALL BE REMOVED TO EXPOSE A QUALITY OF WOOD
WHICH WHEN DRILLED PRODUCES TIMBER PARTICLES WITH
A DEGREE OF CONTINUITY OF 2-3mm LENGTH, NOT A POWDER.
